svg.aria-label: gauntlet-verify, a Claude skill for work that cannot afford to be mediocre or wrong. Reference mode holds a build to a shipped bar with an isolated critic and blind judges; verification mode has isolated verifiers try to kill every claim and label each one verified, reported, or unverified. Shown as one beam running a gauntlet of rings into a glass prism, watched by two isolated seats, and split into green, amber and red rays.

g.text: Build to a shipped bar. Verify claims with
agents that never saw your reasoning.
